messages:
lauren_sales: Heads-up 1FinEdge2 legal pinged asking for a compact compliance packet for the POC. They want: redacted SOC2 excerpt, ISO27001 confirmation, signed pen-test attestation (must name test window + state no outstanding criticals at issuance), 1-page network diagram, and staging access steps. Also asked whether Dedicated can be single-tenant and ballpark uplift. Need to ship today if possible.

david_security: I can put together the SOC2 excerpt and the pen-test draft. For the attestation we need the testing window inserted and the explicit phrase about no outstanding criticals. Who signs? Usually Head of Security.

sangeeta_eng: I'll sketch a minimal network diagram and include the staging creds workflow. Staging creds are ephemeral, read-only by default, TTL 7d. Snippet to include: `./tools/create-staging-creds --project finedge --role read-only --ttl 7d`. Will also attach sample allowed-endpoints JSON.

oliver_ps: Confirm Dedicated single-tenant is available (reserved pool + private VPC). Ballpark uplift ~+30% for short POC; exact depends on GPU family and burst. I'll DM a quick estimate to @lauren_sales.

lauren_sales: Legal wants the attestation to explicitly list the testing dates and state no outstanding criticals. Can you draft and route to Legal for signature?

david_security: Draft ready: ```
[Redwood Letterhead]
Date: [MM/DD/YYYY]
To: [Customer]
Subject: Penetration Test Attestation

Redwood Inference retained [3rd-party vendor] to perform a penetration test covering the scoped production and staging components between [start date] and [end date]. At the time this letter was issued, there were no outstanding critical vulnerabilities identified in the scoped systems that would materially affect confidentiality, integrity, or availability.

Signed,
[Head of Security]
```

Routing to Legal now.

legal_assist: Evidence bundle uploaded: https://internal.box.com/s/redwood/fe-poc-evidence-v1.zip (sales+security view). :package:

sangeeta_eng: Added a 1-paragraph data-handling note: POC logs default masked, retention 30 days, no PII persisted. Also included network diagram link: https://box.internal/diags/fe-poc-netdiag (internal).

lauren_sales: Can we get the signed attestation by Thursday EOD? Customer is pressing.

david_security: I'll escalate to Legal; if no major redlines we should have signature by Thu EOD. Also noting: attestation scoped to tested environment only. If FinEdge wants org-wide attestation that's a separate request.

lauren_sales: Perfect. I'll send the bundle and note scope-limited attestation incoming. Thanks all. :pray:

[thread archived]
